why: Both analyses centre the hedgehog on communications electronics and demote printing, but Analysis 2 keeps electronic printing and composition as an explicit bridge, limits future deals to bolt-ons inside the concept, and admits the hedgehog may flip if printing proves the higher-return business. Analysis 1 miscounts the deals ("five in about six years") and more firmly pushes divesting or harvesting printing lines and moving headquarters, which are the moves the key warns against.
